services.title: Commercial Dental PPO Coverage Requirements Check
services.description: Evaluates a dental service order at sign-time under the commercial dental PPO. For D7210 (surgical extraction) and D6010 (endosteal implant), returns an informational card confirming that NO prior authorization is required and that benefits are active — the negative-result CRD case that UC02b is specifically designed to test, in contrast to UC02a's PA-required result.
